ruleDefinitions.name: Registry Modification Via Regini.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of regini.exe which can be used to modify registry keys, the changes are imported from one or more text files.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\regini\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "REGINI\.EXE") AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(":[^ \]"))
